name: Marine Snow
desc: The endless fall of the deep sea — ragged organic aggregates, not tidy specks, tumbling down through a teal water column with mucus wisps trailing off the big ones, flaring white as they pass the dive light at x/y and dying into the murk beyond it; drops any scene to a thousand metres.

energy.doc: backscatter brightness, aggregate size and how far the dive light reaches

alpha.doc: overlay opacity — governs the murk veil too

hue.doc: water hue (186 teal, 210 cold blue, 150 green shelf water)

x.doc: dive light X — flakes near it flare

style.doc: aesthetic: pale ragged organic aggregates in teal water / crushing-depth cold monochrome, murk dominant / wireframe hulls with interior chords, anatomical / false-colour instrument returns, concentric rings coded by depth

act.doc: dramaturgy: steady endless fall / density swells and thins over minutes as a bloom dies down / the current reverses and the snow rises again
